scripts.myscripts: npm run build:lambdas && npm run build:website
scripts.tests_and_compile: npm run check:env && npm run test && npm run test:python && npm run myscripts
scripts.mydeploy: npm run tests_and_compile && npm run cdkDeploy
scripts.mydeploy-force: npm run myscripts && npm run cdkDeploy
scripts.mysynth: npm run typecheck && node scripts/aws-exec.mjs cdk synth
scripts.cliS3Deploy: node scripts/aws-exec.mjs aws s3 sync {{websiteDistPath}} s3://{{bucketName}} --delete
scripts.mimeS3Fix: node scripts/aws-exec.mjs aws s3 cp s3://{{bucketName}} s3://{{bucketName}} --recursive --exclude "*" --include "*.js" --content-type application/javascript --metadata-directive REPLACE
scripts.s3deploy: npm run tests_and_compile && npm run cliS3Deploy && npm run mimeS3Fix && npm run cacheInvalidation
